'''''Markhamia''''' is a genus of flowering plants in the family [[Bignoniaceae]]; species are recorded from Africa and South-East Asia.<ref name=POWO/> The genus is named after [[Clements Markham]].<ref>{{cite journal| journal=Journal of Botany, British and Foreign| volume=1 |url=https://archive.org/stream/journalofbotanyb01londuoft#page/n253/mode/2up/| title=Revision of the natural order Bignoniaceae|pages=225–228|author=Seemann, Berthold|year=1863}}</ref>
